answer: Every new agent identity must first solve a verifiable-delay puzzle: its registration is a cipher-chained sequence of computations that cannot be parallelized, no matter how much hardware the attacker owns. An ocean of cheap fake accounts becomes expensive, because each Sybil identity costs one full delay interval of real time -- cloning costs patience, not just chips. Like a dune, standing grows grain by grain, so a swarm cannot precompute reputation overnight. Puzzles whose timings cluster are flagged and must be redone, doubling the attacker's time cost per clone.
